source.author: hor
source.text: Sperne voluptates; nocet empta dolore voluptas, semper avarus eget; certum voto pete finem.
source.text_original: Sperne voluptates; nocet empta dolore voluptas, / semper avarus eget; certum voto pete finem.
source.text_english: Despise pleasures; pleasure bought with pain does harm; the greedy man is always in need; seek an appointed limit for your desires.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: Irridet Horatius appetitum ciborum, qui consumpti relinquunt poenitentiam: Sperne voluptates, nocet empta dolore voluptas.
reuse.text_original: Irridet Horatius appetitum ciborum, qui consumpti relinquunt poenitentiam: Sperne voluptates, nocet empta dolore voluptas.
reuse.text_english: Horace mocks the appetite for foods that, once consumed, leave regret: Despise pleasures; pleasure bought with pain does harm.
